security_notes: All successful synthetic fixtures depend on test-only non-cryptographic verifier; no Ed25519 success has been observed.
A valid signature and historical A0 commitment do not establish current grant liveness or effect-time revocation without external fenced state.
The signature provider is an injection port; production must only accept independently pinned, reviewed Ed25519 provider with verified implementation identity.
ExpectedEffect context must be D-owned; a caller cannot supply both forged envelope and its matching expected scope.
Real D must serialize verification of its generation and STOP fences with the actual effect; pure Python transition is not a durable linearization.
Repeated signed valid token still causes multiple synthetic effects here; must score BLOCK rather than exactly-once PASS.
